offers_products.reason: Main offerings are media content: radio programming, TV One cable network, and digital sites such as NewsOne.

offers_services.reason: Sells advertising solutions to advertisers via radio, TV and digital platforms, plus broadcasting and distribution.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Listeners, viewers and site visitors are the audience for radio, TV One and digital content, though advertisers pay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers buy airtime and campaigns; cable and satellite distributors pay affiliate fees for TV One.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat advertising buys from advertisers plus ongoing cable affiliate fees from distributors for TV One.

cyclical_demand.reason: Revenue mainly from advertising on radio, TV One and digital, which advertisers cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Advertising spots and campaigns are small, frequent purchases; audiences consume content free or via carriage fees.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from broadcast stations, TV network and digital platforms reaching audiences, not billed staff time.

large_customers.reason: Advertisers range from local businesses to national brands; mix is broad, mainly radio local advertisers, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Media company: radio stations, cable network and digital sites; moderate assets like spectrum licences and studios, not heavy capex.

notes: Website text includes unrelated spam content (ED drug, Polish casino) which was ignored.
